content.text: issues.custom is the documented extension axis for custom field values, and it is {} everywhere we can look.

Measured: examples/demo.db 534 of 534 rows have custom = '{}'; the oss mirror 508 of 508, and its raw column contains zero 'customfield_' keys; field_usage has no rows in either. The live default mirror does have one mapped alias (story_points, filled on 187 of 7163) so the machinery works somewhere.

What is unclear — and what this issue is for — is whether that is correct (these sites genuinely map no custom fields) or whether discovery and `fields --apply` are not running when we think they are. The agent-visible consequence is the same either way: "open bugs where severity = Sev1" is not expressible, and the skill forbids reaching into raw.

Investigate first: does a full sync request the field list that fills custom (internal/sync/sync.go:169-170, 720, 802-815), and does `fields --apply` (cmd/gadak/fields.go:393-464) actually persist the mapping. Then, whichever way it lands, document the query shape — json_each(issues_full.custom) — in RECIPES and the skill, which mention neither. Do not add a column per custom field; that is installation-specific.
Found by the Jira-surface gap sweep (track C, score 8/10).
